posts.content: ComfyUI-RMBG: A ComfyUI custom node designed for advanced image background removal and object, face, clothes, and fashion segmentation, utilizing multiple models including RMBG-2.0, INSPYRENET, BEN, BEN2, BiRefNet, SDMatte, SAM, SAM2, SAM3 and GroundingDINO.

ai.title: ComfyUI-RMBG: Multi-model background removal node with RMBG-2.0, BiRefNet, SAM2, SAM3
ai.summary: ComfyUI custom node integrating 10+ background removal and segmentation models including RMBG-2.0, BiRefNet, and SAM variants. Supports advanced object, face, clothes, and fashion segmentation within ComfyUI workflows.
ai.why_important: Consolidates multiple state-of-the-art segmentation models into a single ComfyUI node, eliminating the need to switch between tools for different masking tasks.
ai.learnings: Can integrate multiple specialized segmentation models (RMBG-2.0 for general use, SAM2/SAM3 for object-specific, BiRefNet for fine detail) into a unified ComfyUI workflow.

posts.content: 2d-gaussian-splatting: [SIGGRAPH'24] 2D Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Radiance Fields

ai.title: 2D Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Radiance Fields [SIGGRAPH'24]
ai.summary: SIGGRAPH 2024 paper introducing 2D Gaussian Splatting method that improves geometric accuracy over standard 3DGS for radiance field reconstruction. Implements alternative splatting primitives optimized for surface representation.
ai.why_important: Addresses a core limitation of 3DGS (geometric accuracy) with a peer-reviewed method, enabling more precise reconstruction for production use cases.
ai.learnings: 2D Gaussian primitives can achieve better surface geometry than 3D splats when geometric accuracy is prioritized over rendering speed.

posts.content: mixamo-llm-mocap: Turn any video into a Mixamo-rig animation - GVHMR estimator, spec-driven retarget, FK apply in Blender via MCP. Works with any Mixamo character; built to be operated end-to-end by an AI agent.

ai.title: mixamo-llm-mocap: Video-to-Mixamo animation via GVHMR + Blender FK retargeting
ai.summary: Converts any video into Mixamo-rigged animation using GVHMR pose estimator, spec-driven retargeting, and FK application in Blender via MCP. Works with any Mixamo character and designed for end-to-end AI agent operation.
ai.why_important: Automates the full mocap-to-Mixamo pipeline (estimation → retarget → apply) with standardized spec-driven approach, enabling AI agents to handle animation tasks.
ai.learnings: GVHMR pose estimation can be piped directly into Mixamo rigs via FK retargeting in Blender, creating a reproducible video-to-animation workflow.

posts.content: LichtFeld-Studio: Train, inspect, edit, automate, and export 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes from a single native application.

ai.title: LichtFeld-Studio: Native app for training, editing, and exporting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes
ai.summary: Native desktop application that combines training, inspection, editing, automation, and export of 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes in one unified interface. Eliminates the need for separate command-line tools and manual pipeline stitching.
ai.why_important: Bridges the gap between 3DGS research implementations and production workflows by providing a cohesive authoring environment for practitioners.
ai.learnings: 3DGS workflows can be consolidated into a single native application that handles the full pipeline from training to export, reducing tool-switching friction.

ai.title: Toonflow: 开源AI短剧工具，集成剧本、分镜、角色与视频生成
ai.summary: 开源桌面端AI工具，将小说/剧本转化为动画短剧，集成AI编剧、智能分镜、角色生成和视频生成功能。跨平台部署，支持低成本批量内容产出。
